content: Atɩtɩfɔ Amándɩ́ɛ́
Mʋ́ ɔma a, Farisifɔ pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ akʋ botsu Yerusalem ba Yesu wá, bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ,
“Ntogyi sʋ́ fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋtamagyi anɩ anáin amándɩ́ɛ́sʋ́. Bʋtamafwɩ́ ɩbɩ amándɩ́ɛ́ ɔkpasʋ asa bʋtegyi atɔ́?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩ anáin amándɩ́ɛ́ sʋ mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ Bulu mbla ámʋsʋ gyí?
Mose lɔ́wanlɩ́n wá Bulu mbla ámʋtɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Bu fʋ́ sɩ́ mʋa fʋ́ yín,’ ɔlɛtrá wanlɩ́n ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́blɩ́ asʋkpan tsú mʋ sɩ ntɛ́ɛ mʋ yin ɩwɩ á, bʋmɔ́ɔ mʋ?’

Támɛ mlɩ mʋ́ mlɩaa, ɔha ɔbɛ́talɩ́ bláa mʋ sɩ ntɛ́ɛ mʋ yin ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Tɔ́á tɛkɩ nɔ́pʋhá fʋ́ á, napʋ́há Bulu. Imehián ánɩ́ nɛ́trá kɩ fʋ.’ Mlɩ anáin amándɩ́ɛ́ sʋ mlɩtráa mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ Bulu mblasʋ gyí.
Apinabwɛbí abwɛpʋ́! Ɔnɔkwalɩ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yesaia lɛ́blɩ́ tsú mlɩ ɩwɩ tswɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: ‘Ahá ánfɩ bʋdɛpʋ amʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bú mɩ́,
támɛ amʋ́ klʋn bʋ ɩfɔ́ mɩ́ wá.
tsúfɛ́ basí Bulu mbla tswɩ, yɔ́ bʋdɛ anyánkpʋ́sa mbla suná.’ ”

content: Tɔ́á Ɩtɔkpɔ́ɩ́ Ɔha Bulu Ansɩ́tɔ́
Yesu lɛ́trá tɩ ɔdɔm amʋ ba mʋ ɩwɩ wá, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyaa asʋ, mɛ́nɩ mlónu ɩ́nɩ asɩ.
Megyí tɔ́á ɔha tegyi tɔ́kpɔ́ɩ́ mʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́, mboún mʋ́á ɩtɛdálɩ tsu mʋ ɔnɔ́ tɔ́kpɔ́ɩ́ mʋ.”
Ɩnʋ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛba mʋ wá bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Fʋyin ánɩ́ fʋ́ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ anfɩ lawɔ Farisifɔ ámʋ?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bópulí oyígyíoyí ánɩ́ megyí mɩ́ Sɩ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbʋ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ ámʋ lóswíe tsitsá.
Mlɩsi Farisifɔ ámʋ asʋ́n. Ansibi abwiepʋ́ bʋgyi, bʋdɛ ansibi abwiepʋ́ kpa. Nɩ́ nsibi obwiepʋ́ dɛ́ nsibi obwiepʋ́ kpa á, ɔbɔ́tɔ́ amʋ́ abanyɔ́ bʋtɛkpá wíé.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Lɛ yébi amʋ asɩ suna anɩ.”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩtamanú asʋ́n asɩ?
Mlɩméyín ánɩ́ tɔ́á iwíé ɔha ɔnɔ́ á, mʋ iputɔ itowíé, ɔtɛyɛ́lɛ mʋ́ wá ɔkpʋntɔ?
Asʋ́ngyíasʋ́n ánɩ́ ɩtɛdálɩ tsu ɔha ɔnɔ́ á, mʋ klʋntɔ ɩ́tɛdálɩ tsu. Mʋ́tɔkpɔ́ɩ́ mʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́ nɩ́.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔha klʋntɔ ágywɩɩn laláhɛ tɛdálɩ tsu. Mʋ́tɛ́há ɔtɔmɔ́ ɔha, ɔtɔtɔ́ mbʋa, ɔtɔwá atsɩ mʋ́a ayin asʋ́n, otowí atɔ́, ɔtɔwá afunu, otetsii ɔha.
Ɩ́nɩ aná tɔ́kpɔ́ɩ́ ɔha, támɛ nɩ́ ɔha mɔ́fwɩ ɩbɩ amándɩ́ɛ́ ɔkpasʋ asa olegyi atɔ́ á, ɩtamakpɔ́ɩ́ mʋ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́.”
Ɔtsɩ Ɔkʋá Omegyí Yudayin Hógyi
Yesu lɛ́natɩ́ ɩnʋ yɔ́ Tiro mʋ́a Sidon nsáɩntɔ.
Kanaanyintse ɔkʋá otsie ɩnʋ lɛ́ba Yesu wá. Ɔdɛ okitikíti sʋrá, olokokóli Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Dawid mʋ na, wun mɩ nwɛ! Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ mɩ́ bí tsɩ́hɛ́tɔ́. Ɩdɛ mʋ háan dʋbɩ.”
Támɛ Yesu mɛ́kpla mʋ. Ɩnʋ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bobwií ɩpa há mʋ bɛɛ “Ha ɔtsɩ ámʋ ɔnatɩ, tsúfɛ́ obuo anɩ ɔdɛ okitikíti sʋrá dʋbɩ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa ɔtsɩ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Israel akúfa fwɩhɛ́ pɛ́ wá Bulu lɔ́wa mɩ́.”
Támɛ ɔtsɩ ámʋ lɛ́da akpawunu mʋ ayabitɔ, bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, gyi mɩ bʋalɛ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩma alɛá fɔ́swɩɩ́ nyebí atogyihɛ pʋ́há akɩ́aɩ.”
Ɔtsɩ ámʋ lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́ alɩ, támɛ akɩ́aɩ ɛ́ bʋtegyi atogyihɛ mpupubi ánɩ́ ɩtɛkpákpa bun amʋ́ wíe ɔpʋ́nʋ́asɩ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtsɩ, fʋ́ hógyi lomoní. Ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́ ha fʋ alɩá fʋdeklé.” Ɩnʋnʋ ɩwɩ lɔ́wa mʋ bi ámʋ ɔnlɩn.
Ahá Tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ Ɩlɔ Tsa
Tsú ɩnʋ á, Yesu lɔ́tsʋn Galilea ɔpʋ ɔnɔ́, dʋ́ yétsiá okúku kʋsʋ.
Ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɔpʋ abubúpʋ, ansibi abwiepʋ́, abɔ, amúmu pʋ́ ɩlɔ bámbá alɔpʋ́ bobun Yesu ayabiasɩ, ɔlɛtsa amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Ahá ámʋ ɔnɔ́ lobwie amʋ́ brɛ́á bowun amúmu bʋdɛtɔɩ́, abubúpʋ ɩwɩ lawá amʋ́ ɔnlɩn, abɔ bʋna, ansibi abwiepʋ́ ɛ́ bʋdɛ atɔ́ wúun, bɛkanfʋ́ Israel Bulu ámʋ.
Ahá Mpɩ́m-na Atogyihɛ Ha

Yesu lɛ́tɩ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ahá ánfɩ asʋ́n dɛ mɩ́ nwɛ wa. Ndɛ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́ ɔpá bʋbuo mɩ, bʋtráa bʋma tɔtɔá bégyi. Nɩ́ nɛhá amʋ́ bɔpʋ́ akʋ́n nátɩ́ á, ansɩ́tɔ́ béyebi amʋ́ ɔkpatɔ.”
Mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Nkʋ́nʋ́ abénya atogyihɛ há ɔdɔm anfɩ dimbí ánfɩsʋ?”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bodobodo afɩnɩ mlɩbʋ?” Bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Asienɔ́ pʋ́ aye pútúpútú kpalobí kʋ.”
Yesu lɛ́ha ɔdɔm amʋ betsiá asɩ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ olotsu bodobodo asienɔ́ pʋ́ aye amʋ, dá Bulu ɩpán, olebiabía mʋ́tɔ́ há akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ, beye ha amʋ́.
Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ begyi mwɛ. Bɔtɔsɩ́ síanhɛ amʋ bʋ́lá alakpá yílé asienɔ́.
Ayin ánɩ́ begyi atɔ́ ámʋ nkʋlɛ bʋgyi mpɩ́m-na (4,000). Bʋmɛkla atsɩ mʋ́a nyebí.
Ɩnʋ Yesu lési ahá ámʋ ɔkpa, olowie ɔklʋntɔ fá ɔpʋ yɔ́ Magadanfɔ ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ.
